Nioh 3: Complete Edition Announcement Trailer
As a celebration of the 10th anniversary of the Nioh series, Nioh 3: Complete Edition will make its debut on XBOX Series X|S in an exciting first for the franchise. 

The digital edition of the base game will also be available simultaneously on January 28, 2027. Digital pre-orders for Nioh 3: Complete Edition for XBOX Series X|S are now open.

NBA 2K27 | Season 3 Trailer
The neon glow and hustle of Rockstar’s Vice City comes to NBA 2K27 in an extended, seven-week Season 3, running from November 27th through to January 15th. Vice City-inspired content and rewards span every corner of the Season experience, from a brand-new Vice City-inspired Park in The City to themed apparel including Vice City and Los Santos jerseys, Burger Shot and Cluckin’ Bell Employee Outfits, and much more.

Arctic Drive XBOX Release Trailer
Explore and survive in the Arctic, where your car is the only thing keeping you alive. Arctic Drive is a 1–4 player co-op survival sim set in a procedurally generated winter wilderness. Find supplies, repair your rig, and haul it all onwards with only one hope left: there must be safety out there. 

*Includes PC Gameplay
